hints.title: Contiguous Block Inversion
hints.text: Flipping an entire contiguous segment of identical characters removes that block in one operation.

hints.title: Target Homogeneity
hints.text: Evaluate making every character '0' versus making every character '1'.

hints.title: Block Run Counting
hints.text: Count the number of contiguous runs of '0's and '1's in a single pass.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating all permutations of range flips requires exponential search.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Evaluates block counts using constant scalar variables.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize that the minimal operations equal the number of minority contiguous runs.
